basic_info.description: Rarely does a a water-view condo come up in this price point. This stunning condo embodies luxurious modern living with its open floor plan, premium amenities, and amazing views. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the space with natural light. The open-concept living and dining areas flow seamlessly into a sleek chef's kitchen with high-end stainless steel appliances and stylish finishesperfect for entertaining.  Step onto the private balcony to enjoy your morning espresso with views of the Bay, Embarcadero, and Oracle Park. Gorgeous hardwood floors throughout, two spacious bedrooms on opposite sides for privacy, and updated bathrooms complete this tasteful space.   Residents enjoy resort-style amenities, including a pool, spa, BBQ area, gym, club room, business center, and 24-hour concierge. This unit also includes 1-car garage parking and storage.  Located in the heart of South Beach, minutes from Oracle Park, MoMo's, The Rooftop at Hotel VIA, and 21st Amendment Brewery. Don't miss this prime opportunity for upscale city living!
